passages.text: “As for you, son of man, take a sharp sword, use it as a barber’s razor, and shave your head and beard. Then take a set of scales and divide the hair.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
Ezekiel was a prophet.
God called Ezekiel “son of man.”
God gave Ezekiel a command.
God told Ezekiel to take a sharp sword.
God told Ezekiel to use the sword like a barber’s razor.
God told Ezekiel to shave his head.
God told Ezekiel to shave his beard.
God told Ezekiel to take a set of scales.
God told Ezekiel to divide the hair using the scales.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֨ה בֶן־ אָדָ֜ם קַח־ לְךָ֣׀ חֶ֣רֶב חַדָּ֗ה תַּ֤עַר הַגַּלָּבִים֙ תִּקָּחֶ֣נָּה לָּ֔ךְ וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ֥ עַל־ רֹאשְׁךָ֖ וְעַל־ זְקָנֶ֑ךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ לְךָ֛ מֹאזְנֵ֥י מִשְׁקָ֖ל וְחִלַּקְתָּֽם׃

passages.text: When the days of the siege have ended, you are to burn up a third of the hair inside the city; you are also to take a third and slash it with the sword all around the city; and you are to scatter a third to the wind. For I will unleash a sword behind them.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel, the son of man.
God told Ezekiel to divide his hair into three parts.
Ezekiel must burn one third of the hair inside the city.
He must do this when the days of the siege are complete.
Ezekiel must take another third of the hair.
He must strike this third with a sword all around the city.
He must scatter the last third of the hair to the wind.
God said, “I will send a sword after them.”
passages.original: שְׁלִשִׁ֗ית בָּא֤וּר תַּבְעִיר֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעִ֔יר כִּמְלֹ֖את יְמֵ֣י הַמָּצ֑וֹר וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת־ הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֗ית תַּכֶּ֤ה בַחֶ֙רֶב֙ סְבִ֣יבוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁית֙ תִּזְרֶ֣ה לָר֔וּחַ וְחֶ֖רֶב אָרִ֥יק אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: But you are to take a few strands of hair and secure them in the folds of your garment.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
Ezekiel was a prophet.
God told Ezekiel to act out a message.
God told Ezekiel to take a few strands of hair.
God told Ezekiel to count these hairs.
God told Ezekiel to keep these few hairs safe.
God told Ezekiel to hide them in the folds of his garment.
passages.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ מִשָּׁ֖ם מְעַ֣ט בְּמִסְפָּ֑ר וְצַרְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֖ם בִּכְנָפֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Again, take a few of these, throw them into the fire, and burn them. From there a fire will spread to the whole house of Israel.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Ezekiel.
God tells Ezekiel to take a few strands of hair.
Ezekiel must throw these strands into the fire.
Ezekiel must burn these strands in the fire.
A fire will come out from these burning strands.
This fire will spread to the whole house of Israel.
passages.original: וּמֵהֶם֙ ע֣וֹד תִּקָּ֔ח וְהִשְׁלַכְתָּ֤ אוֹתָם֙ אֶל־ תּ֣וֹךְ הָאֵ֔שׁ וְשָׂרַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בָּאֵ֑שׁ מִמֶּ֥נּוּ תֵצֵא־ אֵ֖שׁ אֶל־ כָּל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘This is Jerusalem, which I have set in the center of the nations, with countries all around her.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He says, “This is Jerusalem.”
I have placed Jerusalem in the center of the nations.
Countries surround Jerusalem on every side.
passages.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֔ה זֹ֚את יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בְּת֥וֹךְ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם שַׂמְתִּ֑יהָ וּסְבִיבוֹתֶ֖יהָ אֲרָצֽוֹת׃

passages.text: But she has rebelled against My ordinances more wickedly than the nations, and against My statutes worse than the countries around her. For her people have rejected My ordinances and have not walked in My statutes.’
passages.sermon:
Jerusalem is a city.
God placed Jerusalem in the center of the nations.
God gave Jerusalem His ordinances and statutes.
The people of Jerusalem rebelled against God's ordinances.
They acted more wickedly than the nations around them.
They broke God's statutes worse than the countries nearby.
The people of Jerusalem rejected God's ordinances.
They did not walk in God's statutes.
passages.original: וַתֶּ֨מֶר אֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֤י לְרִשְׁעָה֙ מִן־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְאֶ֨ת־ חֻקּוֹתַ֔י מִן־ הָאֲרָצ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבִיבוֹתֶ֑יהָ כִּ֤י בְמִשְׁפָּטַי֙ מָאָ֔סוּ וְחֻקּוֹתַ֖י לֹא־ הָלְכ֥וּ בָהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You have been more insubordinate than the nations around you; you have not walked in My statutes or kept My ordinances, nor have you even conformed to the ordinances of the nations around you.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He addresses Jerusalem.
He says, “You are more rebellious than the nations around you.
You have not followed My statutes.
You have not kept My ordinances.
You have not even acted like the nations that surround you.
You have not followed their rules either.”
passages.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה יַ֤עַן הֲמָנְכֶם֙ מִן־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבִיבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֔ם בְּחֻקּוֹתַי֙ לֹ֣א הֲלַכְתֶּ֔ם וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֖י לֹ֣א עֲשִׂיתֶ֑ם וּֽכְמִשְׁפְּטֵ֧י הַגּוֹיִ֛ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א עֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Behold, I Myself am against you, Jerusalem, and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He addresses Jerusalem.
He says, “I am against you, Jerusalem.
I Myself stand against you.
I will judge you.
I will carry out My judgments among you.
All the nations will see these judgments.”
passages.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י עָלַ֖יִךְ גַּם־ אָ֑נִי וְעָשִׂ֧יתִי בְתוֹכֵ֛ךְ מִשְׁפָּטִ֖ים לְעֵינֵ֥י הַגּוֹיִֽם׃

passages.text: Because of all your abominations, I will do to you what I have never done before and will never do again.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to Jerusalem.
Jerusalem has committed many abominations.
Because of these abominations, the Lord will act.
The Lord will do something to Jerusalem.
He has never done this before.
He will never do this again.
This action is a response to Jerusalem’s abominations.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתִי בָ֗ךְ אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ עָשִׂ֔יתִי וְאֵ֛ת אֲשֶֽׁר־ לֹֽא־ אֶעֱשֶׂ֥ה כָמֹ֖הוּ ע֑וֹד יַ֖עַן כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבֹתָֽיִךְ׃ס

passages.text: As a result, fathers among you will eat their sons, and sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments against you and scatter all your remnant to every wind.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to Jerusalem.
He says, “Fathers among you will eat their sons.
Sons among you will eat their fathers.
I will execute judgments against you.
I will scatter all your remaining people to every wind.”
passages.original: לָכֵ֗ן אָב֞וֹת יֹאכְל֤וּ בָנִים֙ בְּתוֹכֵ֔ךְ וּבָנִ֖ים יֹאכְל֣וּ אֲבוֹתָ֑ם וְעָשִׂ֤יתִי בָךְ֙ שְׁפָטִ֔ים וְזֵרִיתִ֥י אֶת־ כָּל־ שְׁאֵרִיתֵ֖ךְ לְכָל־ רֽוּחַ׃פ

passages.text: Therefore as surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, because you have defiled My sanctuary with all your detestable idols and abominations, I Myself will withdraw My favor; I will not look upon you with pity, nor will I spare you.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He is the one true God.
He lives forever.
He makes a solemn declaration.
He says, “As surely as I live, this is true.”
You have defiled My sanctuary.
You did this with your detestable idols.
You did this with all your abominations.
Because of this, I will act against you.
I Myself will withdraw My favor from you.
I will not look upon you with pity.
I will not spare you.
passages.original: לָכֵ֣ן חַי־ אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ אִם־ לֹ֗א יַ֚עַן אֶת־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֣י טִמֵּ֔את בְּכָל־ שִׁקּוּצַ֖יִךְ וּבְכָל־ תּוֹעֲבֹתָ֑יִךְ וְגַם־ אֲנִ֤י אֶגְרַע֙ וְלֹא־ תָח֣וֹס עֵינִ֔י וְגַם־ אֲנִ֖י לֹ֥א אֶחְמֽוֹל׃

passages.text: A third of your people will die by plague or be consumed by famine within you, a third will fall by the sword outside your walls, and a third I will scatter to every wind and unleash a sword behind them.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Jerusalem.
God is angry because the people have defiled His sanctuary with idols and abominations.
God announces judgment on the people.
One third of the people will die inside the city.
They will die from plague.
They will die from famine.
One third of the people will die outside the city.
They will die by the sword.
One third of the people will be scattered in every direction.
God will send a sword after those who are scattered.
passages.original: שְׁלִשִׁתֵ֞יךְ בַּדֶּ֣בֶר יָמ֗וּתוּ וּבָֽרָעָב֙ יִכְל֣וּ בְתוֹכֵ֔ךְ וְהַ֨שְּׁלִשִׁ֔ית בַּחֶ֖רֶב יִפְּל֣וּ סְבִיבוֹתָ֑יִךְ וְהַשְּׁלִישִׁית֙ לְכָל־ ר֣וּחַ אֱזָרֶ֔ה וְחֶ֖רֶב אָרִ֥יק אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: And when My anger is spent and I have vented My wrath against them, I will be appeased. And when I have spent My wrath on them, they will know that I, the LORD, in My zeal have spoken.
passages.sermon:
The Lord is speaking.
The Lord is angry with the people.
The Lord will pour out His wrath on them.
The Lord will finish His anger against them.
After this, the Lord will be satisfied.
The people will know that the Lord has spoken.
The Lord speaks with zeal.
The Lord will make sure they know He has acted.
passages.original: וְכָלָ֣ה אַפִּ֗י וַהֲנִחוֹתִ֧י חֲמָתִ֛י בָּ֖ם וְהִנֶּחָ֑מְתִּי וְֽיָדְע֞וּ כִּי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה דִּבַּ֙רְתִּי֙ בְּקִנְאָתִ֔י בְּכַלּוֹתִ֥י חֲמָתִ֖י בָּֽם׃

passages.text: I will make you a ruin and a disgrace among the nations around you, in the sight of all who pass by.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Jerusalem.
God will act against Jerusalem.
God will make Jerusalem a ruin.
God will make Jerusalem a disgrace.
Nations surround Jerusalem.
God will do this among those nations.
Everyone who passes by will see Jerusalem's ruin and disgrace.
passages.original: וְאֶתְּנֵךְ֙ לְחָרְבָּ֣ה וּלְחֶרְפָּ֔ה בַּגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבִיבוֹתָ֑יִךְ לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ עוֹבֵֽר׃

passages.text: So you will be a reproach and a taunt, a warning and a horror to the nations around you, when I execute judgments against you in anger, wrath, and raging fury. I, the LORD, have spoken.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking to Israel.
The LORD is just and powerful.
The LORD will judge Israel for their sins.
The LORD will act with anger and wrath.
The LORD will punish Israel with fierce fury.
Israel will become a reproach to other nations.
Israel will be a taunt among the nations around them.
Israel will serve as a warning to those nations.
Israel will become a horror to the nations nearby.
The nations around Israel will see this.
The LORD will execute His judgments against Israel.
The LORD Himself has spoken these words.
passages.original: וְֽהָ֨יְתָ֜ה חֶרְפָּ֤ה וּגְדוּפָה֙ מוּסָ֣ר וּמְשַׁמָּ֔ה לַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבִיבוֹתָ֑יִךְ בַּעֲשׂוֹתִי֩ בָ֨ךְ שְׁפָטִ֜ים בְּאַ֤ף וּבְחֵמָה֙ וּבְתֹכְח֣וֹת חֵמָ֔ה אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃

passages.text: When I shower you with the deadly arrows of famine and destruction that I will send to destroy you, I will intensify the famine against you and cut off your supply of food.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to Israel.
The LORD sends deadly arrows of famine against Israel.
These arrows bring destruction.
The LORD sends these arrows to destroy the people.
The LORD increases the famine against Israel.
The LORD breaks their supply of bread.
The people lose their food.
passages.original: בְּֽשַׁלְּחִ֡י אֶת־ חִצֵּי֩ הָרָעָ֨ב הָרָעִ֤ים בָּהֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ לְמַשְׁחִ֔ית אֲשֶׁר־ אֲשַׁלַּ֥ח אוֹתָ֖ם לְשַֽׁחֶתְכֶ֑ם וְרָעָב֙ אֹסֵ֣ף עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְשָׁבַרְתִּ֥י לָכֶ֖ם מַטֵּה־ לָֽחֶם׃

passages.text: I will send famine and wild beasts against you, and they will leave you childless. Plague and bloodshed will sweep through you, and I will bring a sword against you. I, the LORD, have spoken.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is speaking.
The LORD is powerful and judges nations.
The LORD says these words.
I will send famine against you.
I will send wild beasts against you.
The wild beasts will take away your children.
Plague will come upon you.
Bloodshed will pass through your land.
I will bring a sword against you.
I, the LORD, have spoken.
passages.original: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֣י עֲ֠לֵיכֶם רָעָ֞ב וְחַיָּ֤ה רָעָה֙ וְשִׁכְּלֻ֔ךְ וְדֶ֥בֶר וָדָ֖ם יַעֲבָר־ בָּ֑ךְ וְחֶ֙רֶב֙ אָבִ֣יא עָלַ֔יִךְ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃פ
